zh: 标题旁显示版本号，检测到新版时以绿色提示刷新。
en: Show the version beside the title and a green refresh prompt when an update is available.

zh: 点击更新并刷新后展示本次版本的更新内容，历史记录继续保留。
en: Show this release's changes after an update refresh while retaining historical change records.

zh: 切回页面时自动检查更新，离线或检测失败时仍可继续浏览。
en: Check for updates when returning to the page without interrupting browsing when offline or a check fails.

zh: 缩小桌面条目面板宽度并收紧面板与时间轴内边距，让较窄屏幕保留更多浏览空间。
en: Narrow the desktop entry panel and reduce panel and timeline padding to leave more room on smaller screens.

zh: 移动端条目面板改为约半屏，提供顶部向下收起按钮和把手下滑操作；进一步收紧时间轴内部留白。
en: Use a half-height mobile entry panel with a downward collapse button and swipe handle, and reduce internal timeline spacing.

zh: 对齐移动端地图署名提示与缩放按钮，保留署名内容展开功能。
en: Align the mobile map attribution control with the zoom buttons while preserving expandable credits.

zh: 将地图署名提示统一移至顶部GitHub图标旁，电脑和手机均可展开查看来源信息。
en: Move map attribution beside the GitHub icon in the header, with expandable source credits on desktop and mobile.

zh: 地图来源信息改为页面底部常驻显示，无需点击展开；移除移动端重复的年份状态条。
en: Keep map source credits permanently visible at the page bottom without an expandable popup, and remove the redundant mobile year status.

zh: 底部地图来源文字居中显示，并移除背景色。
en: Center the persistent map credits and remove their background.

zh: 修复远距离地点关联线绕向极地、超出地图顶部的问题，保留跨日界线的连续连接。
en: Keep long-distance location connections within the map instead of bending over the poles, while preserving continuity across the date line.
